stories.title: Bristol City fans on Skubala after draw against Wrexham
stories.summary: Bristol City ended their four-game losing run at home with a hard-fought draw against Wrexham.

stories.title: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
stories.summary: A household using a typical amount of energy would see its annual bill rise from £1,723 to £2,166 if this level was sustained for a year.

stories.title: All Blacks great Beauden Barrett close to Bristol move
stories.summary: New Zealand great Beauden Barrett is close to agreeing a deal to join Bristol Bears in what would be one of the highest-profile signings in Prem history.

stories.title: Chemical Brothers and Harry Styles headlining West festivals 2027
stories.summary: Glastonbury, Forwards Festival and Bristol Sounds have all announced headliners for 2027.

stories.title: Industrial estate plagued by '16 years of crime'
stories.summary: People living near the Kingswood industrial estate say they are "fed up" with fires and crime.

stories.title: Boys arrested after fire at BBC series community centre
stories.summary: Three boys remain in police custody after a fire at a community centre that featured in The Outlaws.

stories.title: Climber's horror fall helps test NHS breakthrough
stories.summary: A Bristol climber's life-threatening fall led him to join a trial testing a new NHS treatment.

stories.title: 'Hope' as Black Friday ad ban launches in UK first
stories.summary: Black Friday ads are to be banned across Bristol council-owned spaces for the first time this year.

stories.title: Gloucestershire renamed Bristol Lions for T20 Blast
stories.summary: Gloucestershire will rebrand to Bristol Lions for the T20 Blast from the 2027 season.

stories.title: What happens next after major footbridge collapse?
stories.summary: The central span of the footbridge has now been removed and towed to a dry dock for repairs.

stories.title: Legal action taken against 'most prolific flag erector'
stories.summary: The amount of flags flown across Bristol has decreased by about three-quarters in half a year.

stories.title: Woman struggles to leave home after multiple attacks
stories.summary: Neil Turner, 70, from Bishopsworth, was jailed for nine-and-a-half years for sexual abuse.
